gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-batak: Open curves, wide spacing, zero fuss. Offside is at its best as loosely tracked, unshaded display lettering, while Noto Sans Batak, a sans-serif, does its best with a towering x-height and an e that stays open.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Expressive from the first glance, Offside bends its letters like a single length of wire, curves refusing to close. Noto Sans Bengali brings distinctly open letter mouths, the best thing here.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Commanding yet quiet, Offside draws curves that never close, with no swelling or tapering anywhere in the stroke. And Noto Sans Brahmi, a sans-serif with a high mean line, leaves Offside to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Expressive and a touch stern, Offside gives every part of a letter the same visual mass. Noto Sans Cherokee carries a tall letter band and a gapped e, and shrinking Offside would waste its wide tracking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Thick tails, open curves, no hurry. Offside holds that sturdy line, while Noto Sans Chorasmian, a sans with large x-height and short ascenders, should read smoothly once text keeps running.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Curves that refuse to close define Offside, each carrying the weight of a straight stem. Noto Sans Elbasan brings large lowercase and terminals that never pinch, so give Offside generous size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Commanding, with strokes like a bent paperclip. Offside leads in that wiry line, and Noto Sans Ethiopic follows with a tall, sturdy lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Steady as a technical pen, Offside spreads its curves wide open and never closes them. And Noto Sans Georgian brings the modern, clean openness of its apertures, which is the best quality here.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Commanding, with parts of equal visual mass. Offside is strongest as loosely tracked display lettering, while Noto Sans Glagolitic earns its place at small sizes, where its round letters stay clear.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK lifts its brush ends before curves close. Against Offside's widely tracked, constant stroke, that sans with its large lowercase makes the clearest difference here, a quiet partner to a loud heading.
